system.description:
When you **_roil with anger_**, you do +1 damage until you calm down. But when you **_try to control your_** **_temper_**, roll +WIS: **on a 10+**, you keep your cool and act as you wish; **on a 7-9**, choose 1 from the list below; **on a 6-**, you just lose it—tell the GM what damn fool thing you end up doing.
- Take some deep breaths and count to ten, fuming all the while
- Vent your rage, but tell us how and on what

success.value: you keep your cool and act as you wish

failure.value: you just lose it—tell the GM what damn fool thing you end up doing.
